description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §3.19, §5.10): the fire lesson at the woodcutters' camp, the Greywood's first trolls - shown when the giant walks into the camp (world.area.woodcutters_camp), where a bonfire and a brazier stand by the two trolls.
text: Trolls close their wounds unless they burn. Smash the bonfire or a brazier while a troll stands beside it, or throw a troll into the flames - a burning troll cannot heal.
